query_text.description: Natural language question or instruction to be converted into an SQL query and executed.

db_uri.description: SQLAlchemy connection URI of the database to query, e.g. postgresql+psycopg2://user:pass@host/db. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

api_key.description: API key of the LLM provider named by 'model'. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

model.description: LiteLLM model name used to generate the SQL, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, gemini/gemini-1.5-pro. A bare name means OpenAI.

read_only.description: When true (the default), the database connection itself rejects INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and DROP. Only the postgresql and mysql dialects can be locked down this way; any other dialect fails instead of running unprotected. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.
